name: EntryPrice
description: This keyword will return the latest entry price of the instrument selected.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will return the latest entry price of the instrument selected.

This keyword is generally used in the set exit when using a list of stocks in the strategy

![Example](./images/img-1631883202.png)

The above keyword will return the respective entry prices of the stocks entered from the list

You can compare this keyword with LTP and create SL /Target conditions

parameters.name: Instrument
parameters.description: Underlying symbol or '|ListName|'. Resolves to the entry price of the currently-iterated instrument — typically used in Set Exit when trading a stock list.
